name: Kami No Shisen
source:
"To be born, one must destroy a world."

It is with this belief that Hisagawa Iedo, a figure devoid of any human warmth, constantly attempts to break down any boundary between “protagonist” and “author.” In his raw and lascivious world, his messianic image strives to emerge to guide humanity to its zenith—or to its own decline.
